item.tib: klu yi gtor ma btang ba'i cho ga
item.coloph: klu yi gtor ma btang ba'i cho ga ston pa gshen rab kyis gsungs nas/ de nas dbal bon stag la me 'bar can bstan pa 'phel 'grib kyi dus su dran pa nam mkhas (mkha'i) bsam yas dkor khang du sbas so/ phyis a tsa ra mi gsum gyis gter nas 'don (bton) te gzi bon sgyur (sgur) po la bka' bab nas rim par spel ba'o//
